# AccordionPanel { #anylumino.AccordionPanel }

```python
AccordionPanel(
    widgets=None,
    *,
    titles=None,
    keys=None,
    width='100%',
    height=420,
    resizable=True,
    fit_content=False,
)
```

Lumino accordion panel with titled collapsible sections.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                     | Description                                                                                             | Default   |
|-----------|--------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| widgets   | iterable or mapping      | Child widgets or keyed child mapping. Mapping keys become stable child keys and default section titles. | `None`    |
| titles    | iterable or mapping      | Section titles associated with children.                                                                | `None`    |
| keys      | iterable of str          | Stable child keys for iterable ``widgets``.                                                             | `None`    |
| width     | int, float, str, or None | Widget width.                                                                                           | `'100%'`  |
| height    | int, float, str, or None | Widget height.                                                                                          | `420`     |
| resizable | bool                     | Whether the accordion gets a notebook resize handle.                                                    | `True`    |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [layout_kind](#anylumino.AccordionPanel.layout_kind) | A trait for unicode strings. |
